Both DXC panes (CE's oldest, 1.6.2112, and dxc_trunk) fail identically with the exact
validation error quoted in the issue: "External declaration '...buffer...' is unused."
followed by "Validation failed." -- look at the error text, not just the exit code, since
CE also prints an unrelated "DXIL.dll not found" *warning* on the 1.6.2112 pane that is
noise, not part of the bug. This confirms the defect is present in the oldest CE-hosted
release and unchanged in dxc_trunk: nearly four years of history with no fix. It cannot
show the local Debug build's internal-error signature (see notes.md) because CE runs
Release builds, where the guarding assert is compiled out and this validation error is
what surfaces instead.
